specialty_specific_scores.score_desc: Fibroglandular pattern: ACR C heterogenously dense.

report_summary: Annual high-risk surveillance bilateral breast MRI with IV gadolinium in a BRCA2 pathogenic variant carrier with no personal history of breast cancer. Mild background parenchymal enhancement, ACR C heterogeneously dense fibroglandular pattern. No suspicious mass, non-mass enhancement, focal enhancement or architectural distortion in either breast. Normal axillary lymph nodes bilaterally and no internal mammary chain lymphadenopathy. Normal bilateral breast MRI with no evidence of malignancy; RCR Right MRI 1, Left MRI 1. Continue annual MRI surveillance per NICE high-risk protocol.
